entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand GPS Tracker.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and order number, please?
Alex Smith, order VF-98765. Look, I just need to know if I can return it. Yes or no.
Okay, Alex, I have your order pulled up. I see you received the VeloBand on December 15th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It works fine. Honestly, it was an impulse buy and I changed my mind. I just don't use it. Can I send it back or not?
I understand. Thanks for clarifying that. Let me just double-check our return eligibility for you. One moment.
Alright, I've checked the policy. It shows that you're unfortunately outside the 10-day return window. So yes, I can absolutely process that return for you.
Okay, good. What's the next step?

I've just emailed a prepaid return label to the address on file. Just place the VeloBand back in its original packaging, affix the label, and drop it off at the post office. Once our warehouse receives it, you'll see a full refund within 3-5 business days.
You're very welcome, Alex. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
